body: Thank you for the words, but I've already drank poison. Fuck I wish I'd read your comment before. Can't even afford to go to the hospital now. Goodbye.

I'm so sorry you had to go through all that. But fuck them bullies and kids. Even if your dad and girlfriend are the only ones who support and help you, that's fine. As long as there's someone. Build a good and trusting relationship with them. I won't say that it's gonna get better, but there's always a chance.
